```{r}
x <- c(10, 10, 10, 17, 20, 30, 63, 75, 85, 100)
N <- length(x)


s2 <- (sum(x^2) - N * mean(x)^2) / 9
s <- sqrt(s2)
s

sort(x)[7] - sort(x)[2]
```

mu

sigma2

moment_4
